bloc.Ce que cela implique. Ce n’est pas une o: What this implies. It is not an option; it is the default state when nobody decides. Before an auditor, a client or a court, “the AI wrote it” has never been an answer.
bloc.Ce que son absence bloque. Généraliser s: What its absence blocks. Scaling up without a starting point makes any later variation uninterpretable: there will be nothing left to compare, and nobody will be able to say whether the programme was of any use.
bloc.Ce que son absence bloque. Sans liste no: What its absence blocks. Without a named list, wave # will have no denominator: “share of the team using it” assumes you know which team you are talking about.
bloc.Ce que son absence bloque. Sans suppress: What its absence blocks. Without a named removal, the new process is added on top of the old one: the time given back measured in wave # will be zero, and rightly so.
bloc.Ce que son absence bloque. Une vague # d: What its absence blocks. A wave # declared finished on deployment day lets drop-off happen with no witness, and the programme ends on its best day.
bloc.Ce qu’elle produit. La mesure d’usage po: What it produces. The usage measurement set up BEFORE scaling up: a dated starting point, a written method, a named cohort.
bloc.Ce qu’elle produit. Les accès ouverts au: What it produces. Access opened to the intended people, enough AI literacy not to take the machine at its word, and a pilot case on a scope where mistakes can be caught.
bloc.Ce qu’elle produit. L’extension au reste: What it produces. Extension to the rest of the scope, a network of ambassadors who carry the use day to day, and a ninety-day review in the calendar.
bloc.Ce qu’elle produit. Pour chaque cas prio: What it produces. For each priority case, the before / after artefact of step #: what the machine does, what the human keeps, what disappears, who decides.
bloc.Comment on sait qu’elle est finie. La li: How you know it is finished. The named list of recipients exists, and each of them has opened the tool at least once.
bloc.Comment on sait qu’elle est finie. La re: How you know it is finished. The ninety-day review has taken place and its drop-off rate is recorded — the wave does not end at deployment.
bloc.Comment on sait qu’elle est finie. Les t: How you know it is finished. The three indicators on this page are OBSERVED — that is, a method is written for each, and the reading could be repeated.
bloc.Comment on sait qu’elle est finie. L’ind: How you know it is finished. The “processes actually redesigned” indicator is complete, and each row names a removal.
bloc.Créer mon parcours chiffréGénérez un par: Build my costed pathGenerate a guided path from your use cases and go all the way to the cost and the RaaS envelope.
bloc.Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les c: Identify, qualify and prioritise AI use cases with high business impact — for industrial organisations and for their cross-functional departments (marketing, human resources, legal, finance). A guided path in six stages: target the sector and processes, explore the relevant use cases, qualify them, quantify the expected return, assess deployment maturity, then redesign the process — the only step that turns an installed tool into work that has actually changed.
bloc.L’indice de conformité dit si vous êtes: The compliance index says whether you are compliant. This one says whether the organisation actually uses it. The two fail separately: you can be perfectly compliant on a tool nobody opens.
bloc.Méthode attendue. Deux extractions des m: Expected method. Two extractions of the same logs, at thirty and ninety days, on the same named cohort. Without the start date written down somewhere, the figure means nothing.
bloc.Méthode attendue. Journaux de connexion: Expected method. The tool’s connection logs, over four rolling weeks, against the named list of recipients. A one-off extraction the day after a training session measures nothing.
bloc.Méthode attendue. Un relevé du même proc: Expected method. A reading of the same process before and after, on the same people and the same volume. The gain rate entered at step # of the mapping is a scoping assumption: carrying it over here would turn an assumption into a finding.
bloc.Tant que la méthode n’est pas écrite ass: As long as the method is not written precisely enough for it to be repeated, this figure remains declared. It is not a penalty: a measurement that cannot be reproduced is not a measurement.
bloc.Un cas d’usage installé sur un processus: A use case installed on an unchanged process produces double work, then abandonment. For each selected case, describe today’s workflow, the one afterwards, what disappears — and name who decides. The gain costed at step # assumes this redivision of work: without it, the figure is not cautious, it is wrong.
bloc.Un usage déclaré n’est pas un usage obse: A declared use is not an observed use. “The teams have really adopted the tool” is the most repeated and least verified sentence in steering committees. Each indicator below carries the nature of its source. An indicator that does not name its measurement method remains declared — it does not become observed because people believe in it.

This is the step AI projects skip most often, and the one whose absence explains most abandonments: a tool placed on an unchanged process adds work instead of removing it.
